text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 剧场走廊.
Environment: Theatre backstage corridor with repeated doors, practical wall lighting and clear central passage.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram / spatial production design.
Asset: Vicky environment library, scene-005-02, 剧场走廊, 建筑图. Generate one finished independent image, landscape 1536x1024 or larger.
Input image 1 is the existing environment identity reference. Reference board has 2 columns and 3 rows. Use ONLY middle-left for this location; ignore all other places.
Any additional reference is the same scene's concept floor/site plan and is the geometric source of truth. Keep its footprint, entrances, openings, adjacencies, landmark arrangement and orientation fixed.
Request: ONE true flat ORTHOGRAPHIC architectural elevation of the most distinctive facade or interior wall of this space, following the supplied plan. For landscapes or bridges choose one clear lateral terrain/structure profile. Show vertical relationships, openings, stairs or rails where actually present. All elements on their genuine floor levels. Rooms that are adjacent on plan must NEVER become stacked storeys. ONE drawing, no collage, no cutaway dollhouse, no perspective, no fake metric dimensions. Fine architectural linework with original-palette material washes. Label the actual viewing direction.
Maintain the architecture, distinctive objects, material vocabulary and visual character of the original. Do not reuse the reference board as the output. Rationally extrapolate only unseen geometry; it is a coherent concept reconstruction for story staging, not surveyed construction documentation. Use one internally consistent space, not a collage of unrelated rooms. Walls meet logically, doors connect traversable spaces, no blocked entrances or impossible staircases. NO people, NO characters, NO animals, NO silhouettes, NO human figures in reflections or posters, NO logos/watermarks. Small legible English labels only where useful. Avoid busy ornament, repeated generic layouts and unexplained disconnected rooms.
Original design context (use only details compatible with target reference panel): 别演，吻我 · 排练厅正反打／走廊／化妆间／剧场／门厅

STRICT SPATIAL SCOPE: Draw ONLY the target location 剧场走廊. Treat every other reference-board panel as a different unrelated location. Do not import props, cages, benches, stairs, furniture or rooms from other panels. Extrapolate only the immediate target footprint. Do NOT assemble a whole multi-function complex. For a room, confine plan to that room, with adjoining rooms dashed and unshown. For outdoor space show only site boundary and immediately bounding facades, no invented building interiors.
LABEL OVERRIDE: Use only FRONT ELEVATION or INTERIOR ELEVATION as appropriate, not cardinal directions; no fake measurements.
OVERRIDE: The sole attached image is the finalized plan of this target scene. Ignore old multi-panel selection instructions. Follow its layout exactly. Preserve the source genre from context, clear fixed entrances, windows and landmark arrangements. No metric scale or compass labels. For multi-view show A,B,C,D camera labels only. No humans even in posters or statues.

reproduction_note: 根据原场景生成并逐张目视检查的概念空间资料；未展示区域属于设计推演，图间可能存在细节差异；不是实测施工图或可编辑三维模型。独立提示词未经过逐张重生成复现验证。
